name: LiDAR-Camera Fusion
description: Sensor fusion operations: distance-based colorization, region-of-interest extraction, and multi-resolution analysis for combined LiDAR and camera processing.

videos.title: 3D LiDAR Features Extraction & Machine Learning for Cars
LiDAR 3D Point Cloud: Full ML Pipeline & Bounding Box Detection

theory.overview:
LiDAR-Camera fusion combines 3D point cloud data with 2D imagery. A 3D point $P = (X,Y,Z)$ projects to pixel $(u,v)$ via:
$$\begin{pmatrix} u \\ v \\ 1 \end{pmatrix} = \frac{1}{Z} K [R|t] \begin{pmatrix} X \\ Y \\ Z \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$$

intensity_colorization.title: Distance Colorization
intensity_colorization.content: Points coloured by their distance from the origin (0, 0, 0), taken as the sensor position, using the selected colormap. No intensity or reflectance field is read: despite the method id, this is a distance colourisation.

roi_extraction.title: ROI Extraction
roi_extraction.content: Keeps the points inside an axis-aligned box centred on the MEDIAN point of the cloud, whose size per axis is the given fraction of the cloud's extent along that axis.

multi_resolution.title: Multi-Resolution Downsampling
multi_resolution.content: Preview layout: the cloud is voxel-down-sampled at `levels` voxel sizes (base * factor^level) and the copies are placed side by side along +x, so the output coordinates of every level but the first are shifted and do not match the input.

parameters.name: colormap
parameters.description: Colormap of the distance from the origin: 0=custom warm-to-cool ramp, 1=viridis, 2=plasma.

parameters.name: x_range
parameters.description: Fraction (0-1) of the X extent kept, centred on the median point.

parameters.name: y_range
parameters.description: Fraction (0-1) of the Y extent kept, centred on the median point.

parameters.name: z_range
parameters.description: Fraction (0-1) of the Z extent kept, centred on the median point.

parameters.name: voxel_growth_factor
parameters.description: Per-level voxel-size multiplier base (voxel = base * factor**level).
